description: Find CJEU / General Court judgments, orders and AG opinions by meaning. Returns cases with celex (feed to lex_get_document), case number, ECLI, court, date, score and a summary. For short keyword-style queries set hyde: true (better recall, 15 credits instead of 5, +1–3 s; refunded to 5 if it falls back). Cost: 5 credits.

filters.description: Optional filters passed to the semantic index.

court.description: Court name as indexed, e.g. "Court of Justice", "General Court".

hyde.description: LLM query rewriting for terse queries (15 credits).

include.description: ["text"] returns each judgment's full text (large; bounded by maxChars).

limit.description: Max cases (plan cap: FREE 10, STARTER 20, PROFESSIONAL 50, higher 100). One result per case.

maxChars.description: Character budget for hit texts when include is ["text"].

min_score.description: Similarity floor. Default ≈0.7 server-side; lower (0.5) when you got fewer hits than limit, 0 disables it.

query.description: Natural-language question or description of the legal issue.

name: lex_semantic_case_law
title: Semantic search over EU case law
